{{nihongo|'''Miwa Shrine'''|三輪神社|Miwa-jinja|}} is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|ja|神社|lt=Shinto shrine|lt_ja=神社}} located in {{ill|Gifu, Gifu|ja|岐阜市|lt=Gifu|lt_ja=岐阜市}}, {{ill|Gifu Prefecture|ja|岐阜県|lt=Gifu Prefecture|lt_ja=岐阜県}}, {{ill|Japan|ja|日本|lt=Japan|lt_ja=日本}}. Under the {{ill|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|ja|近代社格制度|lt=former shrine ranking system|lt_ja=旧社格}} it was a {{ill|Gō-sha|ja|郷社|lt=district shrine|lt_ja=郷社}}, and it is now a {{ill|Kinpei-sha|ja|金幣社|lt=Kinpei-sha|lt_ja=金幣社}}. Its founding date is unknown, and its annual festival is on the first Sunday of April.

{{-}}

== Overview ==
The date of the shrine's founding is unknown. It is said to correspond to "Miwa Daimyōjin, Senior Second Rank" in the ''Mino no Kuni Jinmyōchō''. By one account it was founded with a spirit divided from {{ill|Ōmiwa Shrine|ja|大神神社|lt=Ōmiwa Shrine|lt_ja=大神神社}} in {{ill|Yamato Province|ja|大和国|lt=Yamato Province|lt_ja=大和国}}. {{ill|Shinchō-ji|ja|真長寺|lt=Shinchō-ji|lt_ja=真長寺}} ("Miwa Shaka") was built as the shrine's ''bettō-ji'' (administering temple).

In the Edo period it is said to have been revered by successive {{ill|Mino gundai|ja|美濃郡代|lt=Mino intendants|lt_ja=美濃郡代}}. It became a {{ill|Gō-sha|ja|郷社|lt=district shrine|lt_ja=郷社}} in {{ill|1873|ja|1873年|lt=1873|lt_ja=1873年}} (Meiji 6). Promotion to prefectural shrine was planned for {{ill|1943|ja|1943年|lt=1943|lt_ja=1943年}} (Shōwa 18) but postponed as the {{ill|Pacific War|ja|太平洋戦争|lt=Pacific War|lt_ja=太平洋戦争}} intensified, and the end of the war meant it never happened.

On 17 March {{ill|1957|ja|1957年|lt=1957|lt_ja=1957年}} (Shōwa 32), the Gifu Prefecture Jinjachō designated it a shrine visited by the head of the prefectural Jinjachō ({{ill|Kinpei-sha|ja|金幣社|lt=Kinpei-sha|lt_ja=金幣社}}, gold grade 39).{{sfn|Kimura|1997|p=21}}

== Deity ==
* {{ill|Ōmononushi|ja|大物主|lt=Ōmononushi no Kami|lt_ja=大物主神}}

== Festivals ==
The "Chigoyama performing arts" dedicated at the spring annual festival (Miwa Matsuri) are designated an intangible folk cultural property of Gifu City.<ref>[https://www.city.gifu.lg.jp/secure/10790/R2miwa_gaid_s.pdf Miwa no rekishi bunka sansaku gaido] (Gifu City). Retrieved 11 September 2021.</ref>

== Location ==
* 965 Miwa, {{ill|Gifu, Gifu|ja|岐阜市|lt=Gifu|lt_ja=岐阜市}}, {{ill|Gifu Prefecture|ja|岐阜県|lt=Gifu Prefecture|lt_ja=岐阜県}}
: In the north of Gifu City.
: Along {{ill|Gifu Prefectural Route 93|ja|岐阜県道93号川島三輪線|lt=Gifu Prefectural Route 93 (Kawashima–Miwa line)|lt_ja=岐阜県道93号川島三輪線}}.

== Access ==
Take a {{ill|Gifu Bus|ja|岐阜乗合自動車|lt=Gifu Bus|lt_ja=岐阜バス}} to the "Miwa Shaka-mae" stop.
* {{ill|JR Gifu Station bus terminal|ja|JR岐阜駅バスターミナル|lt=JR Gifu Station bus terminal|lt_ja=JR岐阜駅バスターミナル}} (north of {{ill|Gifu Station|ja|岐阜駅|lt=Gifu Station|lt_ja=岐阜駅}})
: Stand 12: Takami line for "{{ill|Minoshi Station|ja|美濃市駅|lt=Minoshi Station|lt_ja=美濃市駅}}" or "Chūnō Chōsha".
: Stand 13: Kano Danchi line for "Miwa Shaka-mae".
From {{ill|Meitetsu Gifu bus stop|ja|名鉄岐阜のりば|lt=Meitetsu Gifu bus stop|lt_ja=名鉄岐阜のりば}} (west of {{ill|Meitetsu Gifu Station|ja|名鉄岐阜駅|lt=Meitetsu Gifu Station|lt_ja=名鉄岐阜駅}}), get off at "Miwa Shaka-mae".
: Stand 4: Takami line for "Minoshi Station" or "Chūnō Chōsha"; Kano Danchi line for "Miwa Shaka-mae".
